# Kobold Biology is done (its completion): the Brood-Forge opens, Essence starts at 0.
DA_KB_start = {
	set_country_flag = DA_KB_started
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_KB_essence value = 1 } } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_KB_essence value = 0 }
	}
	DA_KB_refresh = yes
}

# The kobold heritage turned active or dormant (DA_RH_sync_kobold): the band follows it; the inventions switch
# off while it is dormant (doc 67).
DA_KB_sync = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_started }
		DA_KB_refresh = yes
		DA_KB_inv_reconcile = yes
	}
}

# The monthly pulse: past tolerance, the hidden roll of a Rejection or a Mutation.
DA_KB_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			DA_KB_on = yes
			check_variable = { which = DA_KB_band value = 1 }
		}
		country_event = { id = DA_KB_event.20 }
	}
	DA_KB_monthly_works = yes
	DA_KB_forge_tick = yes
}
# The yearly pulse: dragon remains give Essence; the Iron Wyrm ages; the inventions (doc 67): their yields, the
# capacity they book, and the AI's.
DA_KB_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = { DA_KB_on = yes }
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Alchemy_material.Dragon_remains }
			owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_KB_essence value = 2 } }
		}
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_KB_hold_wyrm }
			owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_KB_essence value = 3 } }
		}
	}
	DA_KB_yearly_works = yes
	DA_KB_inv_yearly = yes
}

# Which table a strain event rolls on: Rejection for a Brass-heavy realm, Mutation for a Blood-heavy one, either
# for a mixed one (from the hidden event, where the dice are).
DA_KB_strain_event = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_KB_brass_n which = DA_KB_blood_n } NOT = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_KB_brass_n which = DA_KB_blood_n } } }
		DA_KB_roll_rejection = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_KB_blood_n which = DA_KB_brass_n } NOT = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_KB_brass_n which = DA_KB_blood_n } } }
		DA_KB_roll_mutation = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_KB_brass_n which = DA_KB_blood_n } }
		random_list = {
			50 = { DA_KB_roll_rejection = yes }
			50 = { DA_KB_roll_mutation = yes }
		}
	}
}
DA_KB_roll_rejection = {
	random_list = {
		40 = { set_variable = { which = DA_KB_outcome value = 1 } }
		30 = { set_variable = { which = DA_KB_outcome value = 2 } }
		30 = { set_variable = { which = DA_KB_outcome value = 3 } }
	}
	country_event = { id = DA_KB_event.21 }
}
DA_KB_roll_mutation = {
	random_list = {
		20 = { set_variable = { which = DA_KB_outcome value = 1 } }
		20 = { set_variable = { which = DA_KB_outcome value = 2 } }
		15 = { set_variable = { which = DA_KB_outcome value = 3 } }
		25 = { modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Targeted } set_variable = { which = DA_KB_outcome value = 4 } }
		20 = { modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Targeted } set_variable = { which = DA_KB_outcome value = 5 } }
	}
	country_event = { id = DA_KB_event.22 }
}

	change_variable = { which = DA_KB_essence value = 5 }

		limit = { DA_KB_cult = yes }
		REB = { change_variable = { dragon_cult_hoard = 500 } }
		upgrade_kobold_hoard = yes
	}

	change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 3 }
}

# Life Brick Theory: Genetic Engineering opens for free, as Ducaniel's Laboratory tier III opens it.
DA_KB_life_brick = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_unlocked.genetic_engineering } }
		DA_GE_unlock_path = yes
	}
}

# ---- Step 2 (doc 60) ----
# The ruler mark Brass-Bound (a ruler modifier: it ends with the ruler).
DA_KB_give_mark.Brass = {
	add_ruler_modifier = { name = DA_KB_brass_bound duration = -1 }
}
# The ruler mark Wyrm-Blooded (a ruler modifier: it ends with the ruler).
DA_KB_give_mark.Blood = {
	add_ruler_modifier = { name = DA_KB_wyrm_blooded duration = -1 }
	change_mil = 1
}
# A new ruler (on_new_monarch): each mark the realm still qualifies for, at 50%.
DA_KB_new_ruler = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			DA_KB_on = yes
			DA_KB_has_parts.brass1_4 = yes
		}
		random_list = {
			50 = { DA_KB_give_mark.Brass = yes }
			50 = { }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			DA_KB_on = yes
			DA_KB_has_parts.blood1_4 = yes
		}
		random_list = {
			50 = { DA_KB_give_mark.Blood = yes }
			50 = { }
		}
	}
}
# The ruler died (on_monarch_death): a Molt Ceremony under way ends with them.
DA_KB_ruler_died = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_KB_ceremony_on
	set_variable = { which = DA_KB_ceremony_months value = 0 }
}
# Draconic Awakening and the Molt (their tiles' completion).
DA_KB_awakening = {
	add_ruler_modifier = { name = DA_KB_dragon_touched duration = -1 }
}
DA_KB_molt = {
	remove_country_modifier = DA_KB_dragon_touched
	add_ruler_modifier = { name = DA_KB_dragon_ruler duration = -1 }
	set_country_flag = DA_KB_molted
	decrease_monstrous_25 = yes
}

# Excise a Part: the menu; then a part's path goes (its second path when it has both), half its base ducats back,
# half its Strain (rounded up) stays as a scar for 60 months.
DA_KB_open_excise = {
	country_event = { id = DA_KB_event.45 }
}
DA_KB_excise.Claws = {
	DA_KB_refresh = yes
	set_variable = { which = DA_KB_cut value = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = DA_KB_cutting_Brass
	clr_country_flag = DA_KB_cutting_Blood
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Brass1 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Blood1 has_country_flag = DA_KB_first.Claws_Brass }
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_cutting_Blood
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Brass1 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Blood1 has_country_flag = DA_KB_first.Claws_Blood }
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_cutting_Brass
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Blood1 } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Blood2 } OR = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Brass1 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Brass2 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_cutting_Brass
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Brass1 } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Brass2 } OR = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Blood1 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Blood2 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_cutting_Blood
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_cutting_Brass }
		DA_KB_cut_path.Claws_Brass = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_cutting_Blood }
		DA_KB_cut_path.Claws_Blood = yes
	}
	clr_country_flag = DA_KB_cutting_Brass
	clr_country_flag = DA_KB_cutting_Blood
	DA_KB_add_scar = yes
	DA_KB_refresh = yes
}
DA_KB_cut_path.Claws_Brass = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Brass2 has_country_flag = DA_KB_first.Claws_Blood }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_cut value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Brass2 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_cut value = 1 }
		add_treasury = 200
		clr_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Brass2
		clr_country_flag = DA_RH_done.kobold.KB_Claws_Brass2
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_KB_Claws_Brass2
		clr_country_flag = DA_RH_done.kobold.KB_Claws_Brass2_art
		remove_country_modifier = DA_KB_art.KB_Claws_Brass2
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Brass1 has_country_flag = DA_KB_first.Claws_Blood }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_cut value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Brass1 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_cut value = 1 }
		add_treasury = 100
		clr_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Brass1
		clr_country_flag = DA_RH_done.kobold.KB_Claws_Brass1
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_KB_Claws_Brass1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_first.Claws_Brass }
		clr_country_flag = DA_KB_first.Claws
		clr_country_flag = DA_KB_first.Claws_Brass
	}
}
DA_KB_cut_path.Claws_Blood = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Blood2 has_country_flag = DA_KB_first.Claws_Brass }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_cut value = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Blood2 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Targeted }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_cut value = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Blood2 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Targeted has_country_flag = DA_KB_first.Claws_Brass }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_cut value = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Blood2 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_cut value = 2 }
		add_treasury = 200
		clr_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Blood2
		clr_country_flag = DA_RH_done.kobold.KB_Claws_Blood2
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_KB_Claws_Blood2
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Blood1 has_country_flag = DA_KB_first.Claws_Brass }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_cut value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Blood1 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_cut value = 1 }
		add_treasury = 100
		clr_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Blood1
		clr_country_flag = DA_RH_done.kobold.KB_Claws_Blood1
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_KB_Claws_Blood1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_first.Claws_Blood }
		clr_country_flag = DA_KB_first.Claws
		clr_country_flag = DA_KB_first.Claws_Blood
	}
}

	set_variable = { which = DA_KB_cut value = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = DA_KB_cutting_Brass
	clr_country_flag = DA_KB_cutting_Blood
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Wings_Brass1 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Wings_Blood1 has_country_flag = DA_KB_first.Wings_Brass }
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_cutting_Blood
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Wings_Brass1 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Wings_Blood1 has_country_flag = DA_KB_first.Wings_Blood }
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_cutting_Brass
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Wings_Blood1 } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Wings_Blood2 } OR = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Wings_Brass1 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Wings_Brass2 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_cutting_Brass
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Wings_Brass1 } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Wings_Brass2 } OR = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Wings_Blood1 has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Wings_Blood2 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_cutting_Blood
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_cutting_Brass }
		DA_KB_cut_path.Wings_Brass = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_cutting_Blood }
		DA_KB_cut_path.Wings_Blood = yes
	}
	clr_country_flag = DA_KB_cutting_Brass
	clr_country_flag = DA_KB_cutting_Blood
	DA_KB_add_scar = yes
	DA_KB_refresh = yes
}

	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Mind_Blood1 has_country_flag = DA_KB_first.Mind_Brass }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_cut value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Mind_Blood1 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_cut value = 1 }
		add_treasury = 100
		clr_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Mind_Blood1
		clr_country_flag = DA_RH_done.kobold.KB_Mind_Blood1
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_KB_Mind_Blood1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_first.Mind_Blood }
		clr_country_flag = DA_KB_first.Mind
		clr_country_flag = DA_KB_first.Mind_Blood
	}
}
# The scar: half the Strain cut away, rounded up, for 60 months (a new cut restarts the months).
DA_KB_add_scar = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_KB_cut value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_scar value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_KB_cut value = 2 } }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_scar value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_KB_cut value = 3 } }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_scar value = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_KB_cut value = 4 } }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_scar value = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_KB_cut value = 5 } }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_scar value = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_KB_cut value = 6 } }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_scar value = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_KB_cut value = 7 } }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_scar value = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_KB_cut value = 8 } }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_scar value = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_KB_cut value = 9 } }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_scar value = 5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_KB_cut value = 10 } }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_scar value = 5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_KB_cut value = 11 } }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_scar value = 6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_KB_cut value = 12 } }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_scar value = 6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_KB_cut value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_KB_scar_months value = 60 }
	}
}
# The Molt Ceremony: a year, then the hidden roll (10% fail).
DA_KB_start_ceremony = {
	add_treasury = -1000
	hidden_effect = {
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_essence value = -20 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = -10 }
	}
	set_country_flag = DA_KB_ceremony_on
	set_variable = { which = DA_KB_ceremony_months value = 12 }
}
# The Iron Wyrm: 36 months, then it stands in the capital; it rusts 20 years after its last repairs.
DA_KB_start_wyrm = {
	add_treasury = -3000
	hidden_effect = {
		change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = -100 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = -30 }
	}
	set_country_flag = DA_KB_wyrm_building
	set_variable = { which = DA_KB_wyrm_months value = 36 }
}
DA_KB_wyrm_complete = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_KB_wyrm_building
	set_country_flag = DA_KB_wyrm_built
	set_variable = { which = DA_KB_wyrm_age value = 0 }
	add_country_modifier = { name = DA_KB_iron_wyrm duration = -1 }
	capital_scope = {
		add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_KB_wyrm_lair duration = -1 }
		every_neighbor_province = {
			limit = { owned_by = ROOT }
			add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_KB_wyrm_lair duration = -1 }
		}
	}
	create_general = { tradition = 80 add_fire = 1 add_shock = 1 add_siege = 1 }
	country_event = { id = DA_KB_event.43 }
}
DA_KB_repair_wyrm = {
	add_treasury = -500
	hidden_effect = {
		change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = -20 }
	}
	set_variable = { which = DA_KB_wyrm_age value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_wyrm_rusted }
		clr_country_flag = DA_KB_wyrm_rusted
		remove_country_modifier = DA_KB_iron_wyrm_rusted
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_KB_iron_wyrm duration = -1 }
	}
}
# Step 4 (doc 62): the dragon-priests sing to Nimrith's Offspring; the raids end (as when it is killed).
DA_KB_sing_to_wyrm = {
	2863 = {
		remove_province_modifier = DA_Dragon_raids
		set_province_flag = DA_KB_hold_wyrm
		add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_KB_hold_wyrm duration = -1 }
	}
}
# Step 4: kneeling to the Hunter of the Deeps.
DA_KB_kneel = {
	change_variable = { which = DA_KB_essence value = 5 }
	add_country_modifier = { name = DA_KB_hunter_blessing duration = 9125 }
}
# The monthly pulse of the works: the ceremony, the Iron Wyrm under construction, the scar.
DA_KB_monthly_works = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_ceremony_on }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_ceremony_months value = -1 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_KB_ceremony_months value = 1 } } }
			clr_country_flag = DA_KB_ceremony_on
			country_event = { id = DA_KB_event.41 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_wyrm_building }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_wyrm_months value = -1 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_KB_wyrm_months value = 1 } } }
			DA_KB_wyrm_complete = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_KB_scar_months value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_scar_months value = -1 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_KB_scar_months value = 1 } } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_KB_scar value = 0 }
			DA_KB_refresh = yes
		}
	}
}
# The yearly pulse of the works: the Iron Wyrm ages and, 20 years after its last repairs, rusts.
DA_KB_yearly_works = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_wyrm_built }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_wyrm_age value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { which = DA_KB_wyrm_age value = 20 }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_wyrm_rusted }
			}
			set_country_flag = DA_KB_wyrm_rusted
			remove_country_modifier = DA_KB_iron_wyrm
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_KB_iron_wyrm_rusted duration = -1 }
			country_event = { id = DA_KB_event.44 }
		}
	}
}

		change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = -10 }
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_forging
		set_variable = { which = DA_KB_forge_job value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_KB_forge_months value = 6 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_KB_forge_total value = 6 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_KB_forge_pct value = 0 }
	}
}

	custom_tooltip = DA_KB_on_go_tt.traps
	hidden_effect = {
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.traps
		DA_KB_inv_reconcile = yes
	}
}

	custom_tooltip = DA_KB_off_go_tt.traps

		clr_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.traps
		clr_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_switch.traps
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_switch.traps
		DA_KB_inv_reconcile = yes
	}
}

# The forge's month (DA_KB_monthly): it waits while the kobold heritage is dormant.
DA_KB_forge_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_forging DA_KB_on = yes }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_forge_months value = -1 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_KB_forge_pct which = DA_KB_forge_total }
		subtract_variable = { which = DA_KB_forge_pct which = DA_KB_forge_months }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_KB_forge_pct value = 100 }
		divide_variable = { which = DA_KB_forge_pct which = DA_KB_forge_total }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_KB_forge_months value = 1 } } }
			DA_KB_forge_done = yes
		}
	}
}
# An invention is made: it can be switched on. The player gets the news (DA_KB_event.60).
DA_KB_forge_done = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_KB_forging
	set_variable = { which = DA_KB_forge_last which = DA_KB_forge_job }
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_KB_forge_job value = 1 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_forged.traps
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_KB_forge_job value = 2 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_forged.smelters
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_KB_forge_job value = 3 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_forged.borers
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_KB_forge_job value = 4 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_forged.drakes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_KB_forge_job value = 5 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_forged.stills
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_KB_forge_job value = 6 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_forged.vats
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_KB_forge_job value = 7 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_forged.lattice
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_KB_forge_job value = 8 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_forged.roosts
	}
	set_variable = { which = DA_KB_forge_job value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_KB_forge_months value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_KB_forge_pct value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { ai = no }
		country_event = { id = DA_KB_event.60 }
	}
}
# What the inventions book: taken off Anbennar's ArtificeUpkeep, counted again from the ones switched on, added back,
# then update_artifice_points (as DA_GN_reconcile_capacity). None while switching one on is not allowed (the heritage
# dormant, the Artificers estate or artificery gone). Then the count: the Graft-Lattice's tolerance.
DA_KB_inv_reconcile = {
	subtract_variable = { which = ArtificeUpkeep which = DA_KB_inv_booked }
	set_variable = { which = DA_KB_inv_booked value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_KB_inv_on_n value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { DA_KB_inv_allowed = yes } }
		clr_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.traps
		clr_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.smelters
		clr_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.borers
		clr_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.drakes
		clr_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.stills
		clr_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.vats
		clr_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.lattice
		clr_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.roosts
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.traps }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_inv_booked value = 10 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_inv_on_n value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_KB_inv.traps } }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_KB_inv.traps duration = -1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.traps } }
		remove_country_modifier = DA_KB_inv.traps
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.smelters }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_inv_booked value = 10 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_inv_on_n value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_KB_inv.smelters } }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_KB_inv.smelters duration = -1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.smelters } }
		remove_country_modifier = DA_KB_inv.smelters
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.borers }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_inv_booked value = 20 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_inv_on_n value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_KB_inv.borers } }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_KB_inv.borers duration = -1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.borers } }
		remove_country_modifier = DA_KB_inv.borers
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.drakes }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_inv_booked value = 30 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_inv_on_n value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_KB_inv.drakes } }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_KB_inv.drakes duration = -1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_KB_inv_art.drakes } }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_KB_inv_art.drakes duration = -1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.drakes } }
		remove_country_modifier = DA_KB_inv.drakes
		remove_country_modifier = DA_KB_inv_art.drakes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.stills }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_inv_booked value = 10 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_inv_on_n value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_KB_inv.stills } }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_KB_inv.stills duration = -1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.stills } }
		remove_country_modifier = DA_KB_inv.stills
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.vats }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_inv_booked value = 10 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_inv_on_n value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_KB_inv.vats } }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_KB_inv.vats duration = -1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.vats } }
		remove_country_modifier = DA_KB_inv.vats
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.lattice }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_inv_booked value = 20 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_inv_on_n value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_KB_inv.lattice } }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_KB_inv.lattice duration = -1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.lattice } }
		remove_country_modifier = DA_KB_inv.lattice
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.roosts }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_inv_booked value = 30 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_inv_on_n value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_KB_inv.roosts } }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_KB_inv.roosts duration = -1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.roosts } }
		remove_country_modifier = DA_KB_inv.roosts
	}
	change_variable = { which = ArtificeUpkeep which = DA_KB_inv_booked }
	update_artifice_points = yes
	DA_KB_refresh = yes
}
# Yearly: while the capacity is short, the dearest invention switches off (tier III first). The player is told.
DA_KB_inv_over_capacity = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.roosts
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 0 } }
		}
		DA_KB_switch_off.roosts = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_overcap.roosts
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_overcap
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.drakes
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 0 } }
		}
		DA_KB_switch_off.drakes = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_overcap.drakes
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_overcap
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.lattice
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 0 } }
		}
		DA_KB_switch_off.lattice = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_overcap.lattice
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_overcap
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.borers
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 0 } }
		}
		DA_KB_switch_off.borers = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_overcap.borers
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_overcap
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.vats
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 0 } }
		}
		DA_KB_switch_off.vats = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_overcap.vats
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_overcap
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.stills
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 0 } }
		}
		DA_KB_switch_off.stills = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_overcap.stills
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_overcap
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.smelters
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 0 } }
		}
		DA_KB_switch_off.smelters = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_overcap.smelters
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_overcap
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_KB_inv_on.traps
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 0 } }
		}
		DA_KB_switch_off.traps = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_overcap.traps
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_overcap
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_overcap ai = no }
		country_event = { id = DA_KB_event.61 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_overcap ai = yes }
		DA_KB_clear_overcap = yes
	}
}
DA_KB_clear_overcap = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_KB_overcap.roosts
	clr_country_flag = DA_KB_overcap.drakes
	clr_country_flag = DA_KB_overcap.lattice
	clr_country_flag = DA_KB_overcap.borers
	clr_country_flag = DA_KB_overcap.vats
	clr_country_flag = DA_KB_overcap.stills
	clr_country_flag = DA_KB_overcap.smelters
	clr_country_flag = DA_KB_overcap.traps
	clr_country_flag = DA_KB_overcap
}
# Yearly: the capacity counted again, the over-capacity rule, the yields of a full year switched on, the AI's.
DA_KB_inv_yearly = {
	DA_KB_inv_reconcile = yes
	DA_KB_inv_over_capacity = yes
	if = {
		limit = { had_country_flag = { flag = DA_KB_inv_on.smelters days = 365 } }
		change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { had_country_flag = { flag = DA_KB_inv_on.stills days = 365 } }
		change_variable = { which = DA_KB_essence value = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			ai = yes
			DA_KB_on = yes
			NOT = { DA_AI_level_none = yes }
			NOT = { DA_RH_monstrous = yes }
		}
		random = {
			chance = 20
			DA_KB_ai_inventions = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			ai = yes
			DA_KB_on = yes
			NOT = { DA_AI_level_none = yes }
			DA_RH_monstrous = yes
		}
		random = {
			chance = 10
			DA_KB_ai_inventions = yes
		}
	}
}
# The AI (from DA_KB_inv_yearly, 20%% a year, 10%% while monstrous; never at AI strength "None"): it forges the next
# invention of its order while it keeps 200 gold besides the price, and switches one on while 10 capacity stays free.
DA_KB_ai_inventions = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai
	if = {
		limit = { DA_KB_inv_allowed = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_forging } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai }
				DA_KB_can_forge.traps = yes
				treasury = 350
			}
			DA_KB_forge_start.traps = yes
			set_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai }
				DA_KB_can_forge.vats = yes
				treasury = 350
			}
			DA_KB_forge_start.vats = yes
			set_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai }
				DA_KB_can_forge.stills = yes
				treasury = 350
			}
			DA_KB_forge_start.stills = yes
			set_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai }
				DA_KB_can_forge.smelters = yes
				treasury = 350
			}
			DA_KB_forge_start.smelters = yes
			set_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai }
				DA_KB_can_forge.borers = yes
				treasury = 500
			}
			DA_KB_forge_start.borers = yes
			set_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai }
				DA_KB_can_forge.lattice = yes
				treasury = 500
			}
			DA_KB_forge_start.lattice = yes
			set_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai }
				DA_KB_can_forge.drakes = yes
				treasury = 700
			}
			DA_KB_forge_start.drakes = yes
			set_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai }
				DA_KB_can_forge.roosts = yes
				treasury = 700
			}
			DA_KB_forge_start.roosts = yes
			set_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai
		}
	}
	clr_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai }
			DA_KB_can_on.traps = yes
			check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 20 }
		}
		DA_KB_switch_on.traps = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai }
			DA_KB_can_on.vats = yes
			check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 20 }
		}
		DA_KB_switch_on.vats = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai }
			DA_KB_can_on.stills = yes
			check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 20 }
		}
		DA_KB_switch_on.stills = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai }
			DA_KB_can_on.smelters = yes
			check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 20 }
		}
		DA_KB_switch_on.smelters = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai }
			DA_KB_can_on.borers = yes
			check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 30 }
		}
		DA_KB_switch_on.borers = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai }
			DA_KB_can_on.lattice = yes
			check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 30 }
		}
		DA_KB_switch_on.lattice = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai }
			DA_KB_can_on.drakes = yes
			check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 40 }
		}
		DA_KB_switch_on.drakes = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai }
			DA_KB_can_on.roosts = yes
			check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 40 }
		}
		DA_KB_switch_on.roosts = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai
	}
	clr_country_flag = DA_KB_tmp_ai
}

# The window.
DA_KB_open_forge = {
	DA_KB_refresh = yes
	set_country_flag = DA_KB_forge_on
}

	clr_country_flag = DA_KB_forge_on
}

# The next tile of the Kobold page for the AI, as its Start button would start it (from DA_RH_ai_pulse):
# Kobold Biology, Hatcheries, then the Brass parts; Blood only for a Dragon Cult country while Stable.
DA_KB_ai_tile = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			DA_available_research = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Biology }
		}
		DA_start_research = {
			flag = PR_KB_Biology
			time = 24
			arcane = yes
			unstoppable = yes
		}
	}

		limit = {
			DA_available_research = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Hatcheries }

		}
		custom_tooltip = DA_KB_pay_hatcheries_tt
		hidden_effect = { change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = -10 } }
		DA_start_research = {
			flag = PR_KB_Hatcheries
			time = 48
			arcane = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			DA_available_research = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.KB_Claws_Brass1 }
			DA_PR_done.KB_Biology = yes

			DA_KB_not_critical = yes
			DA_KB_price.KB_Claws_Brass1 = yes

			limit = { DA_KB_council_disc.Claws_Brass = yes }

				change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = -8 }

		}
